name: So Long as We Both Shall Live
source:
Manny knows that one day Lobo will be with him. He just has to wait. The signs are all there. Patience is a virtue, after all.

[From [url=https://ragmaan.itch.io/so-long-as-we-both-shall-live]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Manny知道，總有一天Lobo會和自己在一起。他只需要等待。種種跡象都已擺在眼前。畢竟，耐心是一種美德。

[摘自[url=https://ragmaan.itch.io/so-long-as-we-both-shall-live]itch.io[/url]]
